tref.definition: s not conforming to dietary laws
tref.translation: a. (按犹太教食规) 不洁净的, 不可食用的

trefa.translation: a. (按犹太教食规) 不洁净的, 不可食用的

trefle.definition:
n. A species of time; -- so called from its resemblance in
   form to a trefoil.
a. Having a three-lobed extremity or extremities, as a cross;
   also, more rarely, ornamented with trefoils projecting from the edges,
   as a bearing.
trefle.translation: 三叶草, 苜蓿, 车轴草, (纸牌的)梅花；〈建〉三叶饰； croisement en ～ 立体交叉(路)

trefoil.definition: n. an architectural ornament in the form of three arcs arranged in a circle
trefoil.translation:
n. 车轴草, 三叶草
[医] 三叶草, 三叶豆

trefoiled.translation: a. 做成三叶形的, 有三叶模饰的

trefoils.definition:
plural of trefoil
n. an architectural ornament in the form of three arcs arranged in a circle
trefoils.translation:
(trefoil 的复数) n. 车轴草, 三叶草
[医] 三叶草, 三叶豆
